title: Worker screens: the working line kept counting after the turn ended
notes: Seen once on the --screen trial: the worker screen's working line read 'Working… (336s · ↓ 7.1K tokens)' while its foot said ready and pane list said done. A background pnpm test was in flight at the time, which may be what the line counted.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: build the fix at the root, with a test for the decision. Tests must be Windows-safe (path.join, or a win32 guard). Run pnpm test, typecheck and lint. If the card references a GitHub issue, the PR says 'Closes #N'. Do not bump the version.
